## MPC TOOLS 1.5.6

- **Updating a plugin keeps your look.** MPC TOOLS replaces a plugin's whole folder when it updates it, and that used to put the plugin back on Print Plate. It now carries your chosen look (Night Rack or Colour Block) into the new copy.
- **Updating keeps your own files too.** Files a plugin lists as yours, such as PotentialCrates' `channels.txt`, are copied into the new copy. The old folder still goes to the backup folder as before.

## Downloads

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.6-windows-x64.exe`
- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.6-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)
- `SHA256SUMS` to check the files
